C181.name: Tunduma Town Council
C181.documented: heavy rain, floods on the border valleys, strong winds, and earthquake on the rift edge

area.sw: Mji wa Tunduma: kivuko cha mpaka wa Zambia

risk.en: This area is a crowded border town where truck queues, fuel storage and dense markets bring fire, accident and disease risk, and storm water floods unplanned streets.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa mpakani wenye msongamano ambapo foleni za malori, hifadhi ya mafuta na masoko yenye watu wengi huleta hatari ya moto, ajali na magonjwa, na maji ya dhoruba hufurika mitaa isiyopangwa.

advice.en: For those trading and travelling here, it helps to keep exits and drains clear, keep fire extinguishers ready and use latrines and safe water. What raises the risk: storing fuel in homes and shops, trading between the queued trucks, blocking market exits with stock, and letting waste block the drains. Know the open ground away from the fuel depots and the truck queue that traders will move to if a fuel fire or tanker crash happens, and clear it at once when told; report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaofanya biashara na kusafiri hapa, ni vyema kuacha njia za kutokea na mitaro wazi, kuweka vizimamoto tayari na kutumia vyoo na maji salama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuhifadhi mafuta majumbani na madukani, kufanya biashara kati ya malori yaliyopanga foleni, kuziba njia za kutokea za soko kwa mizigo, na kuacha taka ziziba mitaro. Fahamu uwanja wazi mbali na maghala ya mafuta na foleni ya malori ambao wafanyabiashara watahamia moto wa mafuta au ajali ya lori la mafuta ikitokea, na ondokeni mara moja mnapoambiwa; ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C184.name: Ileje District Council
C184.documented: heavy rain, landslides on the highland edge, and valley floods

area.sw: Ileje: miteremko mikali ya nyanda za juu

risk.en: This area has steep, wet highland slopes where heavy rain causes landslides and washouts that cut roads and isolate villages.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko mikali yenye mvua nyingi ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko na kusombwa kwa barabara, hukata barabara na kutenga vijiji.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes, build away from steep cuts and stream banks and keep food reserves. What raises the risk: opening new fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house, building on the stream banks and letting village food stocks run out before the roads close. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy during heavy rain; restock before the rains, because the road may be cut for weeks. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na kingo za vijito na kuweka akiba ya chakula. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kujenga kwenye kingo za vijito na kuacha akiba za chakula za kijiji ziishe kabla barabara hazijafungwa. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji yakitiririka ya matope wakati wa mvua kubwa; jazeni akiba kabla ya mvua, kwa sababu barabara inaweza kufungwa kwa wiki. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C183.name: Mbozi District Council
C183.documented: heavy rain, valley floods, and strong winds

area.sw: Mbozi: nyanda za juu za kahawa na Vwawa

risk.en: This area has coffee highlands and the regional centre Vwawa, where hailstorms damage crops and roofs, run-off erodes slopes and the TANZAM highway brings accident risk.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina nyanda za juu za kahawa na makao makuu ya mkoa Vwawa, ambapo mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao na paa, maji humomonyoa miteremko na barabara kuu ya TANZAM huleta hatari ya ajali.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to fix roofs firmly, keep slopes planted and trade outside the road reserve. What raises the risk: leaving roofs loosely fixed, opening coffee fields on the steepest slopes, building at gully mouths and trading or building inside the road reserve at Vwawa. When hail or a storm is forecast, get children and animals under a solid roof early; know the firm ground away from the gullies that your household will move to when heavy rain sets in on the hills. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kufunga paa imara, kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko na kufanya biashara nje ya hifadhi ya barabara. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuacha paa zisizofungwa imara, kufungua mashamba ya kahawa kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kujenga kwenye midomo ya makorongo na kufanya biashara au kujenga ndani ya hifadhi ya barabara Vwawa. Mvua ya mawe au dhoruba ikitabiriwa, waweke watoto na mifugo chini ya paa imara mapema; fahamu eneo imara mbali na makorongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia mvua kubwa inapoanza milimani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C180.name: Momba District Council
C180.documented: earthquake on the Rukwa Rift, heavy rain, and floods toward Lake Rukwa

risk.en: This area has hot Rukwa valley lowlands where rivers and the lake flood villages and farms, and droughts and wildlife damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina tambarare za joto za bonde la Rukwa ambapo mito na ziwa hufurika vijiji na mashamba, na ukame na wanyamapori huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those farming and fishing here, it helps to keep homes above flood lines, use flood plains seasonally and keep household food reserves. What raises the risk and to the loss: building permanent houses and stores on the lake flats, staying on the low ground while the rivers and the lake are still rising, relying on one crop and opening fields right against the reserve boundary. Know the raised ground and the dry route to it that your village will use when the rivers and Lake Rukwa spread, and move people, stores and animals there as soon as the water begins to rise; report dangerous animals near the villages at once. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya mistari ya mafuriko, kutumia tambarare kwa msimu na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hatari na hasara: kujenga nyumba na maghala ya kudumu kwenye tambarare za ziwa, kubaki kwenye ardhi ya chini mito na ziwa vikiwa bado vinapanda, kutegemea zao moja na kufungua mashamba moja kwa moja mpakani mwa hifadhi. Fahamu eneo lililoinuka na njia kavu ya kufika huko ambayo kijiji chenu kitatumia mito na Ziwa Rukwa vinapotapakaa, na hamisheni watu, akiba na mifugo huko mara maji yanapoanza kupanda; ripoti wanyama hatari karibu na vijiji mara moja. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C182.name: Songwe District Council
C182.documented: Songwe river floods, heavy rain, and strong winds

area.en: Songwe DC: Songwe valley, gold mining and Mkwajuni
area.sw: Songwe DC: bonde la Songwe, uchimbaji dhahabu na Mkwajuni

risk.en: This area has the hot Songwe valley where rivers flash-flood, artisanal gold pits that collapse in the rains, and an active earthquake zone.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina bonde la joto la Songwe ambapo mito hufurika ghafla, mashimo madogo ya dhahabu yanayobomoka wakati wa mvua, na ukanda hai wa matetemeko.

advice.en: For those living and mining here, it helps to fence or backfill pits, build away from river banks and build to earthquake-resistant standards. What raises the risk: digging pits without timbering and working them while rain is falling, building on the river banks in the valley, and putting up heavy unreinforced walls in an active earthquake zone. Keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts and know the higher ground away from the rivers that your household will move to when a flash flood is coming; if the ground shakes, get out into the open away from walls and do not go back in until told. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo, kujenga mbali na kingo za mito na kujenga kwa viwango vinavyostahimili matetemeko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili na kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, kujenga kwenye kingo za mito bondeni, na kujenga kuta nzito zisizoimarishwa katika eneo lenye matetemeko. Mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza na fahamu eneo la juu mbali na mito ambalo kaya yako itahamia mafuriko ya ghafla yanapokuja; ardhi ikitikisika, tokeni nje uwanjani mbali na kuta na msirudi ndani hadi mtakapoambiwa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
